title: Yo-yo with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- string going up from the yo-yo -->
  <line x1="50" y1="8" x2="50" y2="30" stroke="#f5e68a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- loop at the top of the string -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#f5e68a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- yo-yo left half (outer body) -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="30" fill="#ff5d44"/>
  <!-- yo-yo right half inner lip -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="21" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <!-- yo-yo deep centre -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="11" fill="#ff7a59"/>
  <!-- axle hub -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="5" fill="#fff1a8"/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="51" rx="6" ry="7.5" fill="#fff8d6"/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="51" rx="6" ry="7.5" fill="#fff8d6"/>
  <!-- left pupil -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="52" r="3" fill="#5a3a2a"/>
  <!-- right pupil -->
  <circle cx="59" cy="52" r="3" fill="#5a3a2a"/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M40 62 Q50 72 60 62" fill="none" stroke="#5a3a2a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little cheeks -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="59" r="3.5" fill="#ff8fa3" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="59" r="3.5" fill="#ff8fa3" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- shine on outer body top-left -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="40" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#ffd8c2" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
